builtFrom: ticket 071 paid run proposals that are not expected improvements (hand-picked, $0, before any 073 run)

entries.claim: `findMaestroTasks` re-implements `listTaskFiles` of tasks.ts (readdir, keep .md, sort); export `listTaskFiles` and call it.
entries.reason: The copy is a few lines; exporting a tasks.ts internal to the uninstaller couples the uninstall path to the task queue for no behaviour change.

entries.claim: The `TaskClaim` object is built by hand from a `ClaimFile` in `readClaims` and twice in `claimTask`, and `claimSessionName` repeats the check of `nameOf`; add a `toTaskClaim` helper.
entries.reason: Each build site differs in what it passes for `live`; a helper adds an indirection to three one-line literals.
entries.source: f-l1, f-s5 (haiku and sonnet, 6 of 8 runs)

entries.claim: `ensureClaimsDir` copies the .gitignore "*" write of `ensureSessionsRoot` in session-paths.ts; extract a shared `ensureIgnoredDir`.
entries.reason: The comment on the copy says it is replicated exactly on purpose: claims.ts must not import session-paths.ts (leaf module).

entries.claim: The `.claude/maestro-tasks` location is spelled five ways (`TASKS_SUBDIR`, `MAESTRO_TASKS_REL`, inline joins in tasks.ts, epics.ts and claude-preview.ts); export one constant and a `taskRelativePath` helper.
entries.reason: The strings sit in different layers (uninstall, preview, queue) and change together only by accident; one shared constant would tie them.

entries.claim: `withLock` and `sleepSync` of epics.ts are copied in run-metrics.ts (mkdir lock, stale-lock break, retry); extract one shared lock helper with the timeout policy as an option.
entries.reason: The two differ in what a timeout does (epics throws, run-metrics proceeds); a shared primitive with a policy flag is harder to read than two short loops.
entries.source: f-l1, f-l3 (haiku and sonnet, 5 of 8 runs)

entries.claim: `writeReport` and `writeNote` repeat the inbox sequence (next id, mkdir, write header and body, push a log entry); extract a `writeInboxEntry` helper.
entries.reason: The two entries have different headers and log fields; the shared part is five lines of fs calls.

entries.claim: About 17 exported interfaces and types of epics.ts (`EpicWorker`, `EpicState`, `SpawnableTask`, `EpicReadyView`) are imported nowhere; drop their `export`.
entries.reason: They document the module shape and type its public functions; the app and the plugin tooling read them from the barrel.

entries.claim: `readJson` of session-runtime.ts is identical to `readJsonSafe` of config.ts, and marketplaces.ts, skill-availability.ts, detect.ts and run-metrics.ts carry more copies; keep one exported reader.
entries.reason: Each copy has its own failure policy at its call site and some modules must stay free of the config module imports (fs-only bundles).

entries.claim: The owner-run functions (`ownerRunLeftovers`, `closeOwnerRuns`, `endOwnerRuns`) repeat the meeting ones line for line; parameterise one marker-in-session.json family by its key.
entries.reason: The two markers have different lifecycles and are kept apart so that one can change without the other.

entries.claim: `templateNameOf` hand-parses frontmatter with its own regex while agent-fork-record.ts has `splitFrontmatter`; export a name reader from agent-fork-record.ts and use it.
entries.reason: The regex reads one field of a template that may be malformed; reusing the record parser would make a bad template throw.

entries.claim: `pluginVersionFor` repeats the plugin version lookup of `resolveTemplate` / `installedPluginSources` in agent-sync.ts; move it to one shared resolver.
entries.reason: The two answer different questions (the bundled version rule for maestro itself, the installed one for other plugins) and drift on purpose.

entries.claim: `readSessionLog` has no consumer outside the `core/index.ts` barrel re-export; delete it and its barrel entry.
entries.reason: It is the supported reader for a whole log and the barrel is the module contract; the tail reader is the only one the app uses today.

entries.claim: `dedupeProjectRoots` is a project-root utility living in session-log.ts that session-ipc.ts imports across concepts; move it to session-paths.ts.
entries.reason: It belongs to the log reader that dedupes the roots it scans; moving it only trades one cross-concept import for another.

entries.claim: The `readGlobalHandoff` wrapper (a lazy require of maestro-handoff-defaults.cjs that returns null on failure) is copied in maestro-inject-agent-context.js, maestro-subagent-log.js and maestro-resume-target.cjs; move it to one shared module.
entries.reason: Each script is a separate bundle that loads node:sqlite lazily; a shared module would pull it in eagerly.
